name: Scholomance Normal: Lord Alexei Barov's kit Fierce Blow deals one weapon swing
contract: Fierce Blow (975011) is a single melee weapon strike: its only damaging effect is Weapon Percent Damage with
base points 99 and one die side, so it deals 100% of the caster's weapon damage. rev_20261009_20_dungeon_fixes
set every kit Fierce Blow to an untriggered custom cast with base points 100, but #10512 re-inserted Lord Alexei
Barov's (10504) block with the older triggered 200 cast. A landed noncritical Fierce Blow takes his weapon roll,
between weapon_damage_min and at most 1.5 times that, reduced by at most 10% by the hero's armor (600 or less).
CoADungeonNormal then applies its Normal factor 0.512 from coa_dungeon_normal_spell_damage (the CoA damage
control reads 512), and no other modifier changes it. One hit is therefore 0.46-0.77 weapon minimums, while a
200% hit is at least 0.92. The metric reads only Barov's 975011 damage logs, so his melee swings, Shadow Cleave
and Unholy Aura do not count.
